images.title: Stepping stones and running totals
images.purpose: Show the sums of 3 consecutive numbers built stone by stone with a running total, going up by 3 each time and taking turns between odd and even.
images.composition: Three rows of three stepping stones, 10 to 14, each with its running total, ending in the sums 33, 36 and 39, with +3 between them and odd, even, odd tags.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Three rows of stepping stones, each ending in a sum, with the differences between the sums. The title Sums of 3 consecutive numbers in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px) is centred at x 728, y 60. THREE ROWS with centres at y 200, 410 and 620. In each row THREE STONES, each a circle 110 px in diameter filled teal #0072B2 and outlined dark #2B2B2B 3 px, at x centres 330, 560 and 790, holding in white bold sans-serif (60 px) the numbers: row 1: 10, 11, 12; row 2: 11, 12, 13; row 3: 12, 13, 14. Between the stones of a row, two small arrows in dark #2B2B2B (4 px), one from x 395 to x 495 and one from x 625 to x 725 at the row centre. Under each stone, 85 px below the row centre, its running total in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px): row 1: 10, 21, 33; row 2: 11, 23, 36; row 3: 12, 25, 39. In row 1 only, to the left of the first running total, right-aligned at x 245, y 285, the words running total in construction grey #6B7280 bold sans-serif (32 px). At the right of each row: an equals sign in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (64 px) at x 890, then a rounded rectangle outlined green #009E73 (5 px), x 940 to 1140, 90 px tall and centred on the row, holding the sum in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (72 px): 33 in row 1, 36 in row 2, 39 in row 3; then a rounded tag (200 by 70 px, x 1200 to 1400, outlined grey #6B7280 3 px) centred on the row with the word in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px): odd in row 1, even in row 2, odd in row 3. Between the sum rectangles, two down arrows in dark #2B2B2B (4 px) at x 1040, the first from y 245 to y 365 and the second from y 455 to y 575, each with the label +3 in amber #E69F00 bold sans-serif (56 px) to the right of it at x 1105, y 305 and y 515. No other text. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
tags that do not read odd, even, odd from the top
running totals other than 10, 21, 33 and 11, 23, 36 and 12, 25, 39
more or fewer than three stones in a row
images.takeaway: Each run of 3 stones ends on its sum, and the difference between successive sums is 3, the number of numbers added.
images.description: Three rows of stepping stones 10, 11, 12 and 11, 12, 13 and 12, 13, 14 with running totals ending in 33, 36 and 39, the differences +3 and the tags odd, even, odd.
images.context: Concept image for Consecutive Numbers and Their Sums, using the example's own numbers (practice values). The stepping stones and the running total are the same picture as the Consecutive Sums Lab.
images.teaching_notes: Add stone by stone with the running total, then ask why each sum goes up by exactly 3. The slip to watch: thinking successive sums always go up by 1.

image_decisions.why: The stones with their running totals and the three sums side by side make the pattern visible.
